text: Our company will reach net zero by 2040, including Scope 3 emissions.
summary: Half supported. It names a year and covers the whole supply chain, but it doesn't say how offsets will be used and sets no interim milestones.

checks.name: Offsets
checks.tip: A stronger pledge says how much it relies on offsets or carbon removal, and what kind.

checks.name: Interim milestones
checks.tip: A stronger pledge sets a nearer target on the way, e.g. a 50% cut by 2030.

methods.name: Rule-based
methods.label: Net zero
methods.detail: Matched “net zero” and a year. No confidence score: rules either match or don't.
